tasks.deviceEnvironment: Android Chrome at the stable production origin
tasks.steps: Open home/search/workout/nutrition/backup; use portrait and landscape; save synthetic workout and diary records; reload and revisit history.
tasks.passCondition: All controls readable and touchable; records survive reload.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Clipped controls, touch failures, lost saves or console errors.
tasks.severityIfFailed: P1 if data loss; otherwise P2

tasks.steps: Repeat workout/diary/backup flows; rotate; scroll with keyboard open; reload saved synthetic records.
tasks.passCondition: Navigation, keyboard and persistence work without blocked controls.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Keyboard obscures submit, page jumps, inaccessible actions or lost records.
tasks.severityIfFailed: P1 if data loss; otherwise P2

tasks.deviceEnvironment: Physical iPad Safari or Android tablet
tasks.steps: Use split view and rotation; browse food/exercise detail; open filters, comparison and backup dialogs.
tasks.passCondition: Tables scroll, dialogs fit and navigation stays usable.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Overlapping navigation, trapped scroll or clipped actions.

tasks.steps: Start a synthetic workout; log a set; finish; log nutrition; review history/dashboard; open a second tab and reload.
tasks.passCondition: Saved feedback matches persisted records and tab state.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Stale records, duplicate saves, incorrect history or lost edits.
tasks.severityIfFailed: P1 if data loss; otherwise P2

tasks.deviceEnvironment: Desktop and mobile native OS dialogs
tasks.steps: Open /settings/data/backup and click Create backup file; open /settings/data/export and click Export spreadsheet-safe CSV; locate both saved files; on /settings/data/restore cancel and reopen Backup file; select the backup and inspect preview without confirming restore.
tasks.passCondition: Files are usable; cancellation changes no records; preview shows expected counts.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Picker cannot reopen, truncated download, cancellation writes or missing file.

tasks.deviceEnvironment: Android/iOS photo picker with disposable photo
tasks.steps: Open /progress/photos; use Image file to choose a disposable image; click Sanitize and save photo; reload; cancel a second selection; on /settings/data/backup explicitly choose full media and Create backup file; remove the photo using its confirmation.
tasks.passCondition: Image persists locally; cancellation preserves it; backup includes sanitized image when explicitly selected.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Wrong photo, missing image, failed save or unexpected network upload.

tasks.steps: In a disposable profile inspect storage-health/persistence; exercise restricted storage; keep an external backup; clear only disposable site data; prepare storage and restore.
tasks.passCondition: Unavailable storage has honest feedback; restore recovers records; eviction risks understood.
tasks.failureSymptoms: False success, silent data loss, blocked storage without guidance or unusable recovery.

tasks.steps: Tab through navigation/search/forms; open/close dialogs; use Escape; submit and correct invalid inputs; inspect focus after actions.
tasks.passCondition: Visible focus and logical order; no trap; dialog returns focus.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Invisible focus, unreachable controls, trapped focus or unclear errors.
tasks.severityIfFailed: P2; P1 if core flow unusable

tasks.deviceEnvironment: NVDA/Firefox or Chrome; VoiceOver/Safari; TalkBack if available
tasks.steps: Read home, workout, diary, comparison and backup; navigate landmarks/headings; trigger validation and save; inspect dialogs/table captions.
tasks.passCondition: Names, values, errors and status updates are understandable; all core actions reachable.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Unlabelled fields, silent errors/saves, incorrect dialog focus or unusable tables.
tasks.severityIfFailed: P1 if core flow inaccessible; otherwise P2

tasks.deviceEnvironment: Desktop 200%/400% zoom plus mobile larger text
tasks.steps: Increase zoom/text; inspect search, food detail, calculator, history and restore; keep keyboard focus visible.
tasks.passCondition: Text and actions remain usable; only intended table regions scroll sideways.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Clipped text/actions, page-wide overflow or missing focused control.

tasks.deviceEnvironment: Desktop print preview/PDF and printer if available
tasks.steps: Preview public exercise/food/recipe pages and a disposable local summary; inspect page breaks, sources, units and privacy before saving/printing.
tasks.passCondition: Readable output preserves context and sources; chosen private output is intentional.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Missing units/sources, truncated records, unreadable contrast or unexpected private output.

tasks.deviceEnvironment: Owner devices, light/dark themes, reduced motion
tasks.steps: Run one realistic synthetic session; inspect labels, empty/error states, feedback, touch targets and motion in both themes.
tasks.passCondition: Owner can complete flows and distinguish unavailable, unknown and estimated values.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Misleading feedback, ambiguous control, painful contrast or distracting motion.

tasks.deviceEnvironment: Stable origin and owner-controlled normal profile after synthetic tests pass
tasks.steps: Keep an external backup first; enter a small real workout/diary/measurement; edit and reload; export; inspect exact values privately.
tasks.passCondition: Actual values, dates, units and immutable snapshots match the owner’s entries.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Incorrect conversion/date, overwritten snapshot, unexpected sharing or lost record.

tasks.task: Backup custody and independent restore drill
tasks.deviceEnvironment: Private external storage and separate disposable browser profile
tasks.steps: On /settings/data/backup click Create backup file for portable and explicit full-media profiles as needed; copy files outside browser; in a fresh disposable profile open /settings/data/restore and click Prepare local storage; select Backup file; compare preview counts; confirm Replace matching stores only in that disposable profile; reload and compare exact records/media; retain original files privately.
tasks.passCondition: Owner can recover exact records/media and keep unencrypted files private.
tasks.failureSymptoms: Only browser copy exists, unreadable file, count mismatch, missing media or public exposure.

optionalGovernanceRecommendation: Protect main with required checks/review in owner GitHub settings; no settings mutation performed.
